article_title: Judo champion Teddy Riner shakes up French presidential race with surprise candidacy

tasks.prompt: Why has Teddy Riner's candidacy disrupted expectations about the French presidential race?
options: He is the only candidate legally permitted to campaign
His athletic fame and outsider appeal could reshape a fragmented centre despite his lack of political experience
He has already published the most detailed manifesto
Marine Le Pen and Jean-Luc Mélenchon have withdrawn
tasks.correct_answer: His athletic fame and outsider appeal could reshape a fragmented centre despite his lack of political experience
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הפופולריות של רינר ומעמדו כאאוטסיידר עשויים לשנות את מאזן הכוחות במרכז הפוליטי המפוצל, אף שאין לו ניסיון או מצע מלא.

tasks.prompt: What early evidence does the report give of public interest in Riner's campaign?
options: He has already won a first-round election
Every centrist party has endorsed him
More than 28 million watched his campaign broadcast and 22% in an Ifop poll said they could vote for him
He received 11 million formal nominations from officials
tasks.correct_answer: More than 28 million watched his campaign broadcast and 22% in an Ifop poll said they could vote for him
tasks.explanation_hebrew: יותר מ־28 מיליון צפו בסרטון ההכרזה, ו־22% בסקר Ifop אמרו שיוכלו להצביע עבורו.

tasks.prompt: Which key elements of a conventional presidential campaign does Riner still lack?
options: Public-office experience, a party and a manifesto
A social-media account and a campaign slogan
Olympic medals and business experience
A French flag and a hospital visit
tasks.correct_answer: Public-office experience, a party and a manifesto
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לרינר אין ניסיון בתפקיד ציבורי, אין מפלגה מאחוריו ועדיין אין לו מצע.

tasks.prompt: What does “throwing his hat into the ring” mean in the article?
options: Retiring from competitive judo
Formally entering a contest as a candidate
Challenging another athlete to a match
Refusing to join any political debate
tasks.correct_answer: Formally entering a contest as a candidate
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי throwing his hat into the ring פירושו להצטרף רשמית לתחרות, כאן להכריז על מועמדות לנשיאות.

tasks.prompt: How does Riner broadly position himself politically?
options: As a hard-left ally of Mélenchon
As a hard-right successor to Le Pen
In the centre, against political extremes, with right-leaning economic and law-and-order views and a strong stance against racism
As a single-issue candidate focused only on Olympic sport
tasks.correct_answer: In the centre, against political extremes, with right-leaning economic and law-and-order views and a strong stance against racism
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה ממקמת אותו בערך במרכז: ימני יותר בכלכלה ובסדר ציבורי, תקיף נגד גזענות ומתנגד לקיצוניות.

tasks.prompt: What does the report mean when it says Riner's campaign may “fizzle out”?
options: It may gradually lose attention and momentum
It may become more violent
It will automatically reach the final round
It will merge with an Olympic event
tasks.correct_answer: It may gradually lose attention and momentum
tasks.explanation_hebrew: fizzle out פירושו לדעוך בהדרגה לאחר התחלה בולטת, בלי להתפתח לכוח פוליטי משמעותי.

tasks.prompt: Why are established politicians treating Riner seriously even though he has no political record?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר הן את כוחו האישי והן את חולשת המערכת הפוליטית הנוכחית.
expected_points: Riner is one of France's most popular public figures
Mocking him could provoke a backlash from voters
His campaign video attracted a very large audience
France's centre ground is fragmented and lacks an inspiring candidate
Early polling suggests a notable share of voters could consider him

tasks.prompt: Summarise Riner's strengths, weaknesses and likely effect on the presidential contest.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לשלב הון ציבורי והישגים מול חוסר ניסיון ומצע, ולהסביר את השפעתו האפשרית על המרכז והסיבוב השני.
expected_points: His sporting record, business career and popularity give him visibility and a winner's image
He presents himself as an outsider who can unite the country
He lacks public-office experience, a party, a team and detailed policies
The centrist field is already crowded
His entry could divide centrist votes and improve Mélenchon's chances of reaching the final round
His campaign could either fade after the initial hype or force a major electoral recalculation

tasks.prompt: Why might Emmanuel Macron's praise be a “poisoned chalice” for Riner?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשר בין תמיכת הנשיא הלא־פופולרי לבין תדמית האאוטסיידר שרינר מנסה לבנות.
expected_points: Riner's appeal depends partly on not looking like a professional politician
Macron is unpopular and associated with the political establishment
Praise from Macron could make voters see Riner as the president's ally or envoy
Riner therefore rejected the label of Macronist

tasks.prompt: Write a balanced paragraph assessing whether celebrity and outsider status can substitute for political experience in Riner's campaign.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג יתרונות וחסרונות, להשתמש בראיות מהכתבה ולסיים בהערכה מנומקת.
expected_points: Celebrity brought Riner more than 28 million campaign-video views and early polling interest
His record as a champion supports an image of discipline and success
Outsider status can appeal when voters distrust the political system
He still lacks a manifesto, party, governing team and answers on major policy questions
Popularity must be converted into a credible political mandate
A reasoned conclusion should distinguish winning attention from demonstrating readiness to govern
